Definition: Shobal, the name of an Edomite and two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Shobal is the name of an Edomite, a son of Seir the Horite who lived in the land before Edom, and of two Israelites besides. One Shobal fathered Kirjath-jearim in Caleb's line, and the chroniclers keep all three bearers straight in their lists.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God keeps the lines straight even when the names repeat. Three men called Shobal, one Edomite and two Israelites, and I hold that each one is known to Him by his own father's name.
